Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 | 1,000eb, 2 Weeks

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6) • Install: Hospital

Some might call this forceful reallocation of brain power just to make sure you can’t fail. They’re just jealous.

Iconic Neuralware. Requires RAM Manager. RAM Manager now gives its usual bonus after the user fails any form of Interface Check, and the bonus it provides is increased by 1 (+2 Total).

Fabrication: DV24 | 1,000eb, 2 Weeks
Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 0

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
